ad_placement_note: The ad network caps how many opportunities can be ACCEPTED at once. As of 2026-08-02 there were 56 accepted opportunities (from many unsent daily drafts), so placing a NEW offer id from list_ad_offers fails with 'can not accept any more opportunities'. Workaround: embed already-accepted opportunity ids from list_ad_opportunities(status=accepted) with a valid future send_by — these need no new claim and place fine. Filter accepted opps by send_by > target-send timestamp.

established_template.description: AI Current dark theme. Each block wrapped in a node-section div with data-background-color #222222 and data-color #FFFFFF, padding 20. Cover image is a 16:9 imageBlock figure with 30px rounded corners. Story sections use h2 headings (Models & Research, Industry & Business). Sign-off + Share button at the end. Sponsor slots use advertisementOpportunity nodes labeled 'A word from our sponsor' only when offers/agreements exist.
